MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 6
   D. 8

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

3. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 8

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 64
   C. 65
   D. 0

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 15

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

12. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 24.5
   D. 8

13. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 11

14. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 36
   D. 5

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

16. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

17. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

19. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 20
   C. 40
   D. 30

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

22. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
